root.label: Abbas Kamel visits Israel and warns of Gaza danger

events.label: Abbas Kamel visits Israel and warns of Gaza danger

slots.name: visit duration
slots.sentence: Her reporting establishes that Kamel spent approximately 67 minutes in Israel and met with senior Israeli national security officials.

slots.name: visit date
slots.sentence: As Israel's national security establishment gathered to commemorate the 50th anniversary of the Yom Kippur War and one of the country's greatest intelligence failures, Abbas Kamel, then Egypt's intelligence chief, made an exceptionally rare and discreet visit to Israel with a stark warning about the dangerous situation unfolding in Gaza.
